title: The attack-scan method gate evaluates the predicate on every bodyless request and emits the skip event only above DEBUG
quantity: COUNTS of guard evaluations and logger.debug invocations. This artefact makes NO latency claim: S-8's own arithmetic is 0 us, 0.00 % of the 4.09 ms uncontended floor and 0.00 % of the 740 ms p95, so there is no duration to report.

method.request: one bodyless, benign GET through the real AttackDetectionMiddleware ASGI __call__
method.arms: the module's stdlib logger at DEBUG, at INFO, and at NOTSET (inheriting the root)
method.guard_counter: the bound logger's own is_enabled_for, filtered to the module logger, so the GUARD is counted and not the stdlib's internal level check
method.debug_counter: the module proxy's own debug method, so the CALL SITE is counted
method.ip_rules: stubbed; the rules are consulted only when an attack is detected, and none is

machine.host_relevant_why: the quantity is a COUNT of calls, not a duration: the same code and the same configuration produce the same counts on any host

verdict.statement: The guard is evaluated once per bodyless request in EVERY arm, and the skip event is emitted only in the arm whose level permits it: one logger.debug call per request at DEBUG, none at INFO and above.

limits: This is a COUNT, not a latency measurement, and it substantiates a structural property of the call site rather than a performance figure. S-8's own arithmetic stands: 0 us, 0.00 % of the 4.09 ms uncontended floor, 0.00 % of the 740 ms p95.

The requests are driven in-process through the middleware's ASGI __call__ with a stub downstream application, so the counter exercises the middleware and not the whole application stack. The END-TO-END-over-HTTP leg is a separate deliverable.
The middleware's own body scan and detection paths are not exercised: the requests are benign by construction, which is what makes the skip the only event in play.

The counter runs against this repository's logging configuration, installed by setup_logging(). Against structlog's ambient default the predicate is structurally always True and both arms would report a debug call per request.
